body:
## Scope
Synthesis of user opinions, top loves, and top pains across all 20 analyzed competitors.

Raw data: https://github.com/Wladefant/shipnovo/tree/9104135dc7c0bcf8cf2ed6c48fa19fe0a7aeec0d/research/competitors
SERP keyword map: https://github.com/Wladefant/shipnovo/blob/9104135dc7c0bcf8cf2ed6c48fa19fe0a7aeec0d/research/competitors/_serp.md
Other ranking tools: https://github.com/Wladefant/shipnovo/blob/9104135dc7c0bcf8cf2ed6c48fa19fe0a7aeec0d/research/competitors/_others.md

Parent tracker: https://github.com/Wladefant/shipnovo/issues/133

## Acceptance Criteria
- [x] Identify top 15 loves across all 20 competitors.
- [x] Identify top 15 pains to avoid across all 20 competitors.
- [x] Identify initial signed-out dashboard patterns.

---

### Top 15 things users love (match or beat)
1. Fast setup: first shop connected in minutes, with a small guide (Billbee, Sendcloud, Pirate Ship).
2. Many orders from many channels in one list (Billbee, Linnworks, Afterbuy).
3. Bulk labels for 50 to 200 orders in one click (eBay Seller Hub, Billbee, Pirate Ship).
4. If-then rules that pick carrier, tag or status by themselves (Billbee, Linnworks, JTL).
5. Tracking number goes back to eBay automatically.
6. Cheap carrier rates with no per-label fee on the basic tier (Pirate Ship, Sendcloud, JTL).
7. Real phone support and a named contact person (Afterbuy, Xentral).
8. Support that answers in minutes (Billbee).
9. Price shown up front and a trial with no card (Billbee 30 days, Dreamrobot 30 days).
10. Stock stays in sync across channels and accounts.
11. Direct hand-off to invoicing (Lexoffice, easybill).
12. Packing station and scan flow that cuts packing mistakes (JTL, Pulpo).
13. Phone-first selling: camera listing, push alerts, QR-code drop-off with no printer (eBay app).
14. Several eBay accounts in one place (Linnworks, 3Dsellers).
15. Active community with answers (JTL forum).

### Top 15 pains to avoid
1. Big price rises and new fee models after a takeover (Billbee, Afterbuy, JTL, Dreamrobot, Linnworks).
2. Lock-in: long contracts, hard cancellation, data gone at once, pop-ups that cannot be closed (Afterbuy, Billbee).
3. Outages on core flows: order fetch, invoice, label creation (Billbee).
4. Slow order list and a dated interface (Billbee, Afterbuy, Dreamrobot, JTL).
5. Updates that break printing or billing (JTL-Wawi).
6. Heavy setup: Windows service, SQL server, cloud-to-Wawi link that drops (JTL).
7. One bad row stops a whole bulk label run (eBay Seller Hub).
8. No bulk edit of package weight (eBay Seller Hub).
9. Weight corrections after delivery that charge twice (Easyship).
10. Account or wallet frozen by automatic checks, with no phone support (Easyship).
11. Support quality falls after a sale of the company (Dreamrobot, Linnworks).
12. Carrier labels removed from the tool with little notice (Hermes in Billbee).
13. Phone app cannot replace desktop: no copy-paste, no buyer block, forced AI drafts, notification nagging (eBay app).
14. Hidden extras: paid add-ons for formerly free features, paid onboarding (JTL, Linnworks, magnalister).
15. Many Trustpilot DE one-star complaints about a shipping broker (Packlink PRO, 1.1/5 on 1,184 reviews) for unclear charges and claims.

### Dashboard patterns: best and worst
Signed-out scope only. What the public pages and reviews already show:
- Best: eBay Seller Hub gives bulk label and combine-order actions on the order list itself; Pirate Ship has a very short path from signup to first label; Billbee has a guide on first run and a rule engine users praise.
- Worst: "uralte Dashboard" and slow order lists (Billbee, Afterbuy, Dreamrobot, JTL), dense desktop tables with no phone layout, one-error-stops-all bulk runs.
- Rule for the Opus redesign: first screen = one next action ("N Bestellungen versandbereit: Labels drucken"), fast list, bulk with per-row errors, phone card layout.
title: Competitor synthesis: top loves and pains
